guide.step1: Install the Decatron extension (version 0.9.0 or newer) in this browser.
guide.step2: Sign in on twitch.tv in this same browser: the tabs count for that account.
guide.step3: Add your channels to the Multi-view and pick «Lurk: streak only» or «Lurk: full» above. Each tile also has its own setting in the eye on its bar.
guide.step4: The extension opens a separate, minimized window with a regular Twitch tab for each live channel, muted and at the lowest quality. Leave it open (it can stay minimized).
guide.step5: Keep watching here. «Now» shows each channel (whether the tab video is moving and the streak it read) and «History» everything that happened.
guide.streak: Streak only: the tab closes as soon as the streak goes up (the extension reads it from the channel points menu) or after {{max}} minutes if it does not see it go up. Once per stream.
guide.full: Full: the tab stays open the whole stream; it earns points and, with the extension channel points module on, claims the chests.
guide.nosession: If it says «not signed in to Twitch in this browser», sign in on twitch.tv: without it nothing counts.
guide.paused: If it says «video paused by Twitch», the extension tries to resume it; if it cannot, the history says so.
guide.chat: The official chat of each channel is on by default in the Multi-view: it shows your points balance and the extension claims the chests there.
guide.close: If you close a lurk tab yourself, it does not reopen this stream. Closing the Multi-view closes them all.
